notes.title: June 28th Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Made a couple of changes to the final level and parking garage level that hopefully make them more fair/fun/engaging
- When underwater, Fish that are about to break out of your grasp spin just like they do above water
- Tons of collision fixes to prevent fish wall clips
- Added extra hints/tutorials on earlier levels
- Look Sensitivity now saved properly
- Fixed jittering issue with VHS filter

notes.title: March 26th Patch Notes
notes.content: Adjusted length of first level and improved performance on later levels. Also, any changes to the fullscreen/Vhs settings are now saved.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 9th
notes.content: This update includes minor bug fixes and some difficulty balancing for particularly frustrating/confusing levels, notably the cave level

notes.title: Small Patch For Linux Friends
